scope: offline source-backed probes, no PostgreSQL/network/model execution

orders.count.definition: orders created in the requested half-open time window, excluding unpaid and unpaid-cancelled orders

orders.paid_minor.definition: sum of original paid_minor for paid orders created in the requested window

orders.refunded_minor.definition: sum of refunded_minor for those same paid orders, independent of refund-entry count

orders.net_paid_minor.definition: sum of paid_minor minus refunded_minor for those same paid orders

all_created_count.sql_in: SELECT count(*) AS order_count FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at>=:start_at AND created_at<:end_at
all_created_count.sql_out: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "order_count" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" WHERE "cs_order_self"."created_at" >= :start_at AND "cs_order_self"."created_at" < :end_at LIMIT 20

paid_cohort_count.sql_in: SELECT count(*) AS order_count FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at>=:start_at AND created_at<:end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor>0
paid_cohort_count.sql_out: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "order_count" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" WHERE "cs_order_self"."created_at" >= :start_at AND "cs_order_self"."created_at" < :end_at AND "cs_order_self"."trade_status" IN ('paid', 'completed', 'cancelled_refunded', 'closed_refunded') AND "cs_order_self"."paid_minor" > 0 LIMIT 20

registered_sums.sql_in: SELECT count(*) AS order_count,coalesce(sum(paid_minor),0) AS paid_minor,coalesce(sum(refunded_minor),0) AS refunded_minor,coalesce(sum(net_paid_minor),0) AS net_paid_minor FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at>=:start_at AND created_at<:end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor>0
registered_sums.sql_out: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "order_count", COALESCE(SUM("cs_order_self"."paid_minor"), 0) AS "paid_minor", COALESCE(SUM("cs_order_self"."refunded_minor"), 0) AS "refunded_minor", COALESCE(SUM("cs_order_self"."net_paid_minor"), 0) AS "net_paid_minor" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" WHERE "cs_order_self"."created_at" >= :start_at AND "cs_order_self"."created_at" < :end_at AND "cs_order_self"."trade_status" IN ('paid', 'completed', 'cancelled_refunded', 'closed_refunded') AND "cs_order_self"."paid_minor" > 0 LIMIT 20

wallet_cash_refund.sql_in: SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_minor),0) AS refund_minor FROM cs_wallet_entry_self WHERE kind='refund' AND occurred_at>=:start_at AND occurred_at<:end_at
wallet_cash_refund.sql_out: SELECT COALESCE(SUM("cs_wallet_entry_self"."amount_minor"), 0) AS "refund_minor" FROM "cs_wallet_entry_self" AS "cs_wallet_entry_self" WHERE "cs_wallet_entry_self"."kind" = 'refund' AND "cs_wallet_entry_self"."occurred_at" >= :start_at AND "cs_wallet_entry_self"."occurred_at" < :end_at LIMIT 20

sku_semijoin.sql_in: SELECT sku_id,sum(paid_goods_minor) AS paid_goods_minor FROM cs_order_item_self WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at>=:start_at AND created_at<:end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor>0) GROUP BY sku_id ORDER BY sku_id LIMIT 50
sku_semijoin.sql_out: SELECT "cs_order_item_self"."sku_id" AS "sku_id", SUM("cs_order_item_self"."paid_goods_minor") AS "paid_goods_minor" FROM "cs_order_item_self" AS "cs_order_item_self" WHERE "cs_order_item_self"."order_id" IN (SELECT "cs_order_self"."order_id" AS "order_id" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" WHERE "cs_order_self"."created_at" >= :start_at AND "cs_order_self"."created_at" < :end_at AND "cs_order_self"."trade_status" IN ('paid', 'completed', 'cancelled_refunded', 'closed_refunded') AND "cs_order_self"."paid_minor" > 0) GROUP BY "cs_order_item_self"."sku_id" ORDER BY "sku_id" LIMIT 50

order_sku_sum_join.sql_in: SELECT i.sku_id,sum(i.paid_goods_minor) AS paid_goods_minor FROM cs_order_item_self i JOIN cs_order_self o ON i.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY i.sku_id

preaggregate_join.sql_in: WITH i AS (SELECT order_id,sum(paid_goods_minor) AS goods_minor FROM cs_order_item_self GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.order_id,o.paid_minor,i.goods_minor FROM cs_order_self o JOIN i ON o.order_id=i.order_id
preaggregate_join.sql_out: WITH "i" AS (SELECT "cs_order_item_self"."order_id" AS "order_id", SUM("cs_order_item_self"."paid_goods_minor") AS "goods_minor" FROM "cs_order_item_self" AS "cs_order_item_self" GROUP BY "cs_order_item_self"."order_id") SELECT "o"."order_id" AS "order_id", "o"."paid_minor" AS "paid_minor", "i"."goods_minor" AS "goods_minor" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "o" JOIN "i" AS "i" ON "o"."order_id" = "i"."order_id" LIMIT 20

utc_day.sql_in: SELECT date_trunc('day',created_at) AS bucket,count(*) AS order_count FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at>=:start_at AND created_at<:end_at GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket LIMIT 50
utc_day.sql_out: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', "cs_order_self"."created_at") AS "bucket", COUNT(*) AS "order_count" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" WHERE "cs_order_self"."created_at" >= :start_at AND "cs_order_self"."created_at" < :end_at GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', "cs_order_self"."created_at") ORDER BY "bucket" LIMIT 50

utc_week.sql_in: SELECT date_trunc('week',created_at) AS bucket,count(*) AS order_count FROM cs_order_self GROUP BY date_trunc('week',created_at) ORDER BY bucket
utc_week.sql_out: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', "cs_order_self"."created_at") AS "bucket", COUNT(*) AS "order_count" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', "cs_order_self"."created_at") ORDER BY "bucket" LIMIT 20

shanghai_at_time_zone.sql_in: SELECT date_trunc('day',created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS bucket FROM cs_order_self

three_arg_overloaded_status.sql_in: SELECT date_trunc('day',created_at,:status) AS bucket FROM cs_order_self
three_arg_overloaded_status.sql_out: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', "cs_order_self"."created_at", :status) AS "bucket" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" LIMIT 20

shanghai_interval_shift.sql_in: SELECT date_trunc('day',created_at+INTERVAL '8 hours') AS bucket FROM cs_order_self

amount_ratio_guarded.sql_in: SELECT sum(refunded_minor)/sum(paid_minor) AS refund_amount_rate FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at>=:start_at AND created_at<:end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor>0 HAVING sum(paid_minor)>0
amount_ratio_guarded.sql_out: SELECT SUM("cs_order_self"."refunded_minor") / SUM("cs_order_self"."paid_minor") AS "refund_amount_rate" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" WHERE "cs_order_self"."created_at" >= :start_at AND "cs_order_self"."created_at" < :end_at AND "cs_order_self"."trade_status" IN ('paid', 'completed', 'cancelled_refunded', 'closed_refunded') AND "cs_order_self"."paid_minor" > 0 HAVING SUM("cs_order_self"."paid_minor") > 0 LIMIT 20

order_ratio_scalar.sql_in: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at>=:start_at AND created_at<:end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor>0 AND refunded_minor>0)*1.0/(SELECT count(*) FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at>=:start_at AND created_at<:end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor>0) AS refund_order_rate WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM cs_order_self WHERE created_at>=:start_at AND created_at<:end_at AND trade_status IN ('paid','completed','cancelled_refunded','closed_refunded') AND paid_minor>0)>0
order_ratio_scalar.sql_out: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "_col_0" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" WHERE "cs_order_self"."created_at" >= :start_at AND "cs_order_self"."created_at" < :end_at AND "cs_order_self"."trade_status" IN ('paid', 'completed', 'cancelled_refunded', 'closed_refunded') AND "cs_order_self"."paid_minor" > 0 AND "cs_order_self"."refunded_minor" > 0) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "_col_0" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" WHERE "cs_order_self"."created_at" >= :start_at AND "cs_order_self"."created_at" < :end_at AND "cs_order_self"."trade_status" IN ('paid', 'completed', 'cancelled_refunded', 'closed_refunded') AND "cs_order_self"."paid_minor" > 0) AS "refund_order_rate" WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "_col_0" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" WHERE "cs_order_self"."created_at" >= :start_at AND "cs_order_self"."created_at" < :end_at AND "cs_order_self"."trade_status" IN ('paid', 'completed', 'cancelled_refunded', 'closed_refunded') AND "cs_order_self"."paid_minor" > 0) > 0 LIMIT 20

colon_order.sql_in: SELECT order_id FROM cs_order_self WHERE order_id=:order_id
colon_order.sql_out: SELECT "cs_order_self"."order_id" AS "order_id" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" WHERE "cs_order_self"."order_id" = :order_id LIMIT 20

psycopg_order.sql_in: SELECT order_id FROM cs_order_self WHERE order_id=%(order_id)s
psycopg_order.sql_out: SELECT "cs_order_self"."order_id" AS "order_id" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" WHERE "cs_order_self"."order_id" = :order_id LIMIT 20

dollar_order.sql_in: SELECT order_id FROM cs_order_self WHERE order_id=$1

question_order.sql_in: SELECT order_id FROM cs_order_self WHERE order_id=?

id_literal.sql_in: SELECT order_id FROM cs_order_self WHERE order_id='order_A'

left_shipments.sql_in: SELECT o.order_id,s.shipment_id FROM cs_order_self o LEFT JOIN cs_shipment_self s ON o.order_id=s.order_id WHERE s.shipment_id IS NULL
left_shipments.sql_out: SELECT "o"."order_id" AS "order_id", "s"."shipment_id" AS "shipment_id" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "o" LEFT JOIN "cs_shipment_self" AS "s" ON "o"."order_id" = "s"."order_id" WHERE "s"."shipment_id" IS NULL LIMIT 20

count_join_not_grain_blocked.sql_in: SELECT count(*) AS order_count FROM cs_order_self o JOIN cs_order_item_self i ON o.order_id=i.order_id
count_join_not_grain_blocked.sql_out: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "order_count" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "o" JOIN "cs_order_item_self" AS "i" ON "o"."order_id" = "i"."order_id" LIMIT 20

same_named_wrong_fk.sql_in: SELECT o.order_id FROM cs_order_self o JOIN cs_product_public p ON o.order_id=p.sku_id

output_duplicate.sql_in: SELECT o.order_id,i.order_id FROM cs_order_self o JOIN cs_order_item_self i ON o.order_id=i.order_id

status_literal_other_column.sql_in: SELECT order_id FROM cs_order_self WHERE trade_status='topup'
status_literal_other_column.sql_out: SELECT "cs_order_self"."order_id" AS "order_id" FROM "cs_order_self" AS "cs_order_self" WHERE "cs_order_self"."trade_status" = 'topup' LIMIT 20
